step1_analysis.circuit_type: Current-Steering DAC Cell with Active Load
step1_analysis.description: A current-steering DAC cell featuring a cascoded PMOS current source (XM1, XM3) and differential steering switches (XM8, XM9). It is loaded by a local active load or I-V converter formed by a PMOS differential pair (XM4, XM5) and NMOS current sinks (XM6, XM7).

paper_reference.title: A 108dB-DR 120dB-THD and 0.5Vrms Output Audio DAC with Inter-Symbol-Interference-Shaping Algorithm in 45nm CMOS

power_consumption.description: Total power consumption of the individual DAC cell.

sky130_expected.calculation: With VDD=1.8V and PMOS bias N0=0.9V, the current sources (XM1, XM10) provide approx 57uA each. Total current ~114uA. Power = 114uA * 1.8V = 205uW.
sky130_expected.reasoning: The reported 1.1mW is for the entire DAC. A single cell consumes a fraction of this total power.

output_swing.description: Voltage swing at the output node N5 during switching.

sky130_expected.calculation: The diode-connected PMOS (XM4) creates a low-impedance node, compressing the current swing into a moderate voltage swing. Expected swing is around 0.2V to 0.6V peak-to-peak.
sky130_expected.reasoning: The 0.5Vrms reported is the full-scale output of the complete DAC after the final I-V stage. The internal cell swing is typically smaller to keep current sources in saturation.
Requires the full DAC array and Delta-Sigma modulator to simulate accurately.

thd.description: Total Harmonic Distortion of the DAC.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Requires full array simulation with sine wave synthesis to measure linearity and distortion.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure DC power consumption and transient output voltage swing of the DAC cell.
step3_testbench.spice:
* DAC Cell Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u
.param W_xm6=5u L_xm6=0.5u
.param W_xm7=5u L_xm7=0.5u
.param W_xm8=5u L_xm8=0.5u
.param W_xm9=5u L_xm9=0.5u
.param W_xm10=5u L_xm10=0.5u

VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VGND GND 0 0
VN10 N10 0 0
VN7 N7 0 0

* Biases
VN0 N0 0 0.9
VLABEL_NET_1 LABEL_NET_1 0 0.5
VLABEL_NET_4 LABEL_NET_4 0 0.9
VN6 N6 0 0.6

* Input signal (Data)
VLABEL_NET_6 LABEL_NET_6 0 PULSE(1.8 0 1n 0.1n 0.1n 10n 20n)

* DUT
XM1 N11 N0 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 N0 N0 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 N3 LABEL_NET_1 N11 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 N5 N5 N9 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM5 N1 LABEL_NET_4 N9 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}
XM6 N1 N6 N10 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm6} w={W_xm6}
XM7 N5 N6 N7 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm7} w={W_xm7}
XM8 N5 LABEL_NET_6 N3 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm8} w={W_xm8}
XM9 N1 VDD N3 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm9} w={W_xm9}
XM10 N9 N0 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm10} w={W_xm10}

.control
* DC Operating Point
op
let power = -i(VVDD) * 1.8
print power
print v(N5) v(N1)

* Transient Analysis
tran 0.1n 40n
meas tran v_max max v(N5)
meas tran v_min min v(N5)
quit
.endc
